title: Leukemia-intrinsic determinants of CAR-T response revealed by iterative in vivo genome-wide CRISPR screening
reading_scope: Targeted Methods and Results, PMC full text offsets 0 and 20000; 40,000 of 101,277 characters returned
already_tested: Parallel in-vitro and immunocompetent in-vivo CRISPR screens in murine B-ALL showed opposite IFNgR/JAK/STAT-loss directions; isogenic competition validated in-vitro resistance versus in-vivo sensitization; Ptpn2/Fitm2 IFNg-amplification effects, tissue-specific variation, Qa-1b/H2-T23 and NK-related resistance also tested
units: Primary screen is one syngeneic B-ALL model divided into six guide subpools, run across two experiments; validation uses new guides; in-vitro and in-vivo are distinct environments; GL261 validation extends Ifngr1 only
controls: Anti-CD19 CAR-T versus control anti-hEGFRvIII CAR-T (hEGFRvIII absent from tumor); in-vivo headers appear to encode dose-mismatched 10m-vs-15m contrasts and require raw-label confirmation; in-vitro E:T ratios are 1:2 and 1:10; control-CAR arms check baseline fitness
exact_remaining_contrast: A distinct perturbation/outcome/setting beyond the published IFNg sign reversal and in-vitro/in-vivo contrast must be named from the actual data
limitations: Main reversal is in one murine B-ALL model; guide subpools are not independent tumor models; species, antigen, tissue and immune context limit transport claims

title: Targeting autophagy overcomes cancer-intrinsic resistance to CAR-T immunotherapy in B-cell malignancies
reading_scope: Targeted Methods and Results, PMC full text offsets 0 and 20000; 40,000 of 78,540 characters returned
already_tested: Nalm6 genome-wide screen under CD19 CAR-T depleted ATG3/BECN1/RB1CC1 guides; genetic/pharmacologic autophagy inhibition sensitized tumor cells to CAR-T, with validation across B-cell lines, two primary B-ALL samples and Nalm6/Raji xenografts; pre-treatment tumor IHC linked autophagy markers with response in a small lymphoma cohort
units: Discovery screen: Nalm6 at E:T 1:10 for ~48 h; in-vitro validation across several B-cell lines and two patient-derived B-ALL samples; experiments said to be repeated independently at least twice; in-vivo Nalm6/Raji models
controls: Screen compared CD19 CAR-T with vehicle; focused assays used vehicle/drug and multiple E:T ratios; CD19 abundance checked; article does not specify independent replicate count for the discovery screen in inspected Methods
exact_remaining_contrast: Generic tumor-autophagy inhibition or broad B-cell CAR-T sensitization is already published; a distinct candidate must specify different perturbation or measured transport contrast
limitations: Discovery screen is one human B-ALL line and one low E:T CAR-T condition; independent screen replicate count unclear in inspected text; clinical association is small/retrospective and does not establish efficacy
